evidence.observation: T tracks setpoint 750°C within ~0.3°C through growth
P steady ~759 Torr, no drift or spikes
Sensor not installed; telemetry null, so inert-atmosphere integrity (leak/ingress) cannot be verified during growth

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 measurement (or equivalent leak check, e.g. pressure-decay/hold test or downstream O2 analyzer) is needed to confirm the tube atmosphere is oxygen-free; without it a seal leak cannot be excluded even though T, Ar and P are nominal.
